newsitem.title: USA: Wendy's to expand Tim Hortons format in US.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's to expand Tim Hortons format in US.

text.p: Wendy's International Inc said Tuesday it agreed to buy 45 Detroit-area Hardee's restaurants with plans to convert 35 of them into the Tim Hortons coffee-and-breakfast-pastry format.
The move would mark the first major U.S. expansion of the Tim Hortons format, the company said in a statement. Wendy's acquired the Canadian chain last year.

Wendy's said it would buy the restaurants for an undisclosed amount of cash from Hardee's Food Systems Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Imasco Ltd of Montreal. The outlets are company owned, not franchises.

Wendy operates more than 1,300 company-owned and franchised Tim Hortons restaurants, and more than 4,800 Wendy's Old Fashioned Hamburgers Restaurants worldwide. Combined sales of the two chains exceed $5 billion a year.

"This is our first major U.S. initiative with Tim Hortons since we merged with the chain last December, and we are excited about presenting Tim Hortons products to American customers," Gordon Teter, president and chief executive and operating officer of Wendy's, said in the statement.
"It enables us to make a very exciting U.S. expansion move with Tim Hortons, strategically focused near the Canadian border where Tim's quality reputation is already well established," he said.
The move is consistent with Wendy's strategic growth plan, he said. Wendy's last year acquired 40 former Roy Rogers restaurants in the New York metropolitan area.
Ten of the acquired Hardee's units will become Wendy's Old Fashioned Hamburger restaurants.
Wendy's and Tim Hortons built their first combination unit in 1992, before the merger. The restaurant consists of a freestanding building with a shared dining room and separate kitchens and staffs.
About 40 such combination units are open to date, with plans for at least 30 more, Wendy's said.
Development costs are about 25 percent less than for separate units, and peak dining hours for the separate operations ensure steady customer traffic throughout the day, Wendy's said.
